title: Split SRD traps and hazards into structured records
description:
﻿Split D&D SRD 5.1 trap/hazard content into appropriate structured records.

Problem:
The final accuracy audit found trap content contaminating spell:zone-of-truth, and the SRD Traps section contains general trap rules, trap DC/damage tables, and sample traps such as Fire-Breathing Statue, Pits, Poison Darts, Poison Needle, Rolling Sphere, and Sphere of Annihilation. The current importer has limited hazard support and does not clearly represent this trap content as structured records.

Scope:
- First ensure trap text is not included in spell records; if not already fixed by the spell-boundary bead, depend on or coordinate with that fix.
- Parse SRD Traps section content into appropriate structured records.
- Decide during implementation whether traps should use the existing hazard kind or a new trap kind, based on schema fit.
- Capture sample trap names, descriptions, detection/disable information, DC/damage table references, and source provenance where available.
- Import or link trap-related tables consistently with the table parser policy.

Acceptance criteria:
- spell:zone-of-truth does not contain trap text.
- SRD sample traps are represented as structured records or explicitly documented as intentionally omitted with rationale.
- Trap DC/damage tables are imported or linked consistently with the table parser scope.
- Tests cover representative traps: Fire-Breathing Statue, Poison Needle, Rolling Sphere, and Sphere of Annihilation.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 reports no new suspicious findings or only documented reviewed findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not change source vendoring policy.
close_reason: Imported SRD 5.1 Traps as 8 hazard records (trapType discriminator) + 2 trap reference tables; verify exits 0, audit 0 suspicious, all gates pass. PR #147.
